1.name: Episode 1
1.ov: 2004. Frank Lampard, John Terry and Sir Alex Ferguson recall José Mourinho's bold arrival at Chelsea, where he becomes known as "The Special One."

1.name: Episode 2
1.ov: 2007. Power struggles and tensions test the Chelsea manager as he eyes a new challenge in Serie A alongside Zlatan Ibrahimović and Luis Figo.

1.name: Episode 3
1.ov: 2010. Revenge and revolution collide when José Mourinho joins Real Madrid to end the dominance of the rival club he knows all too well...
